instruction: Open the Latest topics view on the FlightAware discussions forum.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent navigated from flightaware.com to discussions.flightaware.com, searched 'community', clicked 'FlightAware Community Discord?' thread, scrolled through it for many turns but never found the topic with most replies (The Banter Thread).
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate flightaware.com, find and click footer links, reach discussions.flightaware.com, use search, click discussion topics, scroll through threads.
metadata.failure_analysis: Model searched for keyword 'community' instead of sorting/browsing topics by reply count. Picked the first search result instead of identifying the topic with the most replies.
metadata.task_rationale: Decomposed to navigation + tab interaction: reach discussions and click 'Latest' tab. Model saw the Categories/Latest/Top tabs (screenshots 10/15) but never clicked Latest or Top.
metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to FlightAware discussions and opening the Latest tab. Evaluator checks that active URL matches discussions.flightaware.com/latest using regex pattern matching.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter active_url_from_accessTree correctly extracts the active tab URL from the accessibility tree, which is the right state for URL verification tasks.
Metric is_expected_url_pattern_match correctly receives the rules dict (with 'expected' key) and performs regex pattern matching against the active URL.
The regex pattern 'https://discussions\.flightaware\.com/latest' correctly matches the target URL with properly escaped dots.
Complete coverage: the single instruction requirement (navigate to Latest topics view on FlightAware discussions) is fully verified by checking the active URL matches the expected pattern.
No postconfig needed since the URL is persistent browser state that doesn't require reopening any dialogs.
